# Examples

24 sample projects ship in [`examples/`](https://github.com/amirhossein-razlighi/Skywalker/blob/main/examples). Most were built by agent crews through the engine's own tools, and every one is original: its own world, characters and story. Open any of them in the editor, render it from the command line, play it in the standalone player, or point an agent at it.

## Tidebreak Isle { #tidebreak_isle }

<video controls muted loop playsinline preload="none" poster="../assets/images/shots/tidebreak_isle/brig.webp"><source src="../assets/video/tidebreak_isle/establishing.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video>

*Open-world Island Adventure* · The storm left you one ship, one map and a cove nobody charts. Make landfall before dark.

An island cove at golden hour, built by an agent crew with the engine's own tools. An erosion-sculpted island with wet sand where the swash reaches, an FFT sea that shoals over the seabed, instanced palms and dune grass, a fort, a brig at anchor and a campfire with volumetric fire. Its hero camera moves ship as sequences, ready for the movie render queue.

| | |
|---|---|
| Folder | [`examples/tidebreak_isle`](https://github.com/amirhossein-razlighi/Skywalker/blob/main/examples/tidebreak_isle) |
| Scenes | `scenes/main.sky.json` |
| Size | 241 entities, 33 behaviors |
| Demonstrates | Eroded terrain, FFT surf, Sequences, Terrain, Foliage, FFT water, Fluid fire and smoke, Particles, Wander, Atmosphere, Volumetric clouds |
| Assets | Poly Haven (CC0), Blender procedural (Skywalker DCC) |

=== "Editor"

    ```bash
    open build/release/bin/Skywalker.app --args --project "$PWD/examples/tidebreak_isle"
    ```

=== "Render a still"

    ```bash
    skywalker render examples/tidebreak_isle/scenes/main.sky.json -o tidebreak_isle.png --scene-camera --samples 8
    ```

=== "Play it"

    ```bash
    skywalker-player examples/tidebreak_isle
    ```

=== "Agent"

    ```bash
    skywalker mcp --project examples/tidebreak_isle --scene scenes/main.sky.json
    ```

## Neon Requiem { #neon_requiem }

<video controls muted loop playsinline preload="none" poster="../assets/images/shots/neon_requiem/avenue_dolly.webp"><source src="../assets/video/neon_requiem/avenue_dolly.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video>

*Open-world Neo-noir RPG* · Halcyon Avenue never sleeps. It just stops remembering.

A rain-soaked neon avenue at midnight with nearly six hundred lights evaluated by clustered lighting, reflective puddles, a monorail, holograms and animated pedestrians (a CC-BY glTF sample character). The city kit was generated in Blender through the DCC bridge.

| Assets | Poly Haven (CC0), Khronos glTF sample CesiumMan (CC-BY 4.0), Blender-generated city kit |

## Ashen Peaks { #ashen_peaks }

<video controls muted loop playsinline preload="none" poster="../assets/images/shots/ashen_peaks/crane_gate.webp"><source src="../assets/video/ashen_peaks/establishing.mp4" type="video/mp4"></video>

*Mythic Action-Adventure* · Nine hundred steps to the Kindled Crane. The lanterns have not gone out in a thousand years.

A monastery valley at a misty sunrise: eroded alpine terrain, forests that turn into octahedral impostors in the distance, lantern-lit stairs, volumetric fires and a mirror lake. It is the scene the foliage impostor measurements in the manual come from.

| Assets | Poly Haven (CC0) + procedural (Blender) |

## Berrybrook { #berrybrook }
